action_args.justification: The series is trend-dominated (slope agreement 0.75) with moderate seasonality and high predictability. The model pool has significant correlated-error redundancy (9 groups, only 6 independent), so pruning to 6 non-redundant models and applying a trimmed mean (trim 0.2) is well-motivated: it removes correlated duplicates while staying robust to the one or two models that may misfit a given window. The 'separated' verdict over the runner-up (margin 0.316) confirms the gain is not noise, and the per-window RMSE (281, 264, 237) shows no single-window blowup. With only 3 validation windows, fitted weights are high-variance; the trimmed mean is the right kind of combination here.
